item.title: Implement ledger.py to SPEC with focused tests
item.brief: Implement `ledger.py` according to repository `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API; handle every specified error and boundary case. Add focused tests beyond the existing basic coverage using only the Python standard library. Run the relevant test suite and commit the implementation and tests on the assigned local branch. Acceptance: behavior matches every SPEC requirement; documented API remains compatible; focused tests cover specified error paths and boundaries; tests pass; commit is present.

pr.body: `ledger.py` validates construction and transfer amounts, keeps a defensive balance copy, serializes transfers and snapshots with one lock, and preserves atomicity, self-transfer, and overflow semantics. `test_ledger.py` adds standard-library validation, boundary, copying, and concurrent opposite-transfer coverage. Checks: `python -m unittest -v` (7 passed); `git diff --check` (passed). No AGENTS.md guidance was found. No known gaps.
pr.summary: Implemented the specified atomic Ledger behavior and expanded boundary and concurrency coverage. Before: API methods were stubs and both tests errored; now: all 7 tests pass.
pr.title: Implement atomic ledger with focused tests

risk.why: Concurrency and locking behavior are introduced; reviewer confirmed the single-lock design and found no blocking or follow-up findings.

The change adds locking and promises linearizable concurrent behavior, which falls under the high-risk rubric. One lock protects account reads, both writes, and snapshots; independent review found no issues.
